The checkboxes and action bar feel clear, and the action set is complete for what I need. Keeping items selected after adding or removing a tag is useful for doing several changes in sequence. The bulk-delete confirmation is an adequate safety check.

“Select all” should mean every bookmark matching the current view and search—not merely the cards currently visible on the page. That distinction will matter once a display limit or multiple pages are involved. The bar should make the scope and total count clear, such as “Select all 137 matching bookmarks.”

With that understanding, EB-04 is settled. Please move on to saved searches.
